scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.build:worker: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-worker ./cmd/kin-worker
scripts.build:egress: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-egress ./cmd/kin-egress
scripts.build:gate: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-slot-gate ./cmd/kin-slot-gate
scripts.format: biome format --write && gofmt -w worker && pnpm -C web format
scripts.format:check: biome format && node scripts/check-gofmt.mjs && pnpm -C web format:check
scripts.check:async-lint: eslint src/lib/admin/resource-owner.mts src/lib/admin/key-scope.mjs src/lib/pool/pool-scheduler.mjs src/lib/pool/failover-runner.mjs src/lib/protocol/handle-protocol.mjs src/lib/protocol/user-count-tokens.mjs src/lib/db/adapters/postgres
scripts.check: npm run check:strict && npm run check:types && npm run check:async-lint && npm run check:type-regressions
